sections.label: Book 38
sections.name: The Pravargya continued: milking the cow

verses.sa: देवस्य त्वा सवितुः प्रसवेऽश्विनोर्बाहुभ्यां पूष्णो हस्ताभ्याम्। आ ददेऽदित्यै रास्नाऽसि॥
verses.tr: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām ā dade'dityai rāsnā'si
verses.en: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pushan. A zone for Aditi art thou.

verses.sa: इड एह्यदित एहि सरस्वत्त्येहि। असावेह्यसावेह्यसावेहि॥
verses.tr: iḍa ehyadita ehi sarasvattyehi asāvehyasāvehyasāvehi
verses.en: Ida, come hither. Aditi come hither. Sarasvati, come hither. Come hither, So-and>So. Come hither, So-and-So. Come hither, So-and-Sot.

verses.sa: अदित्यै रास्नाऽसीन्द्राण्या उष्णीषः। पूषाऽसि घर्माय दीष्व॥
verses.tr: adityai rāsnā'sīndrāṇyā uṣṇīṣaḥ pūṣā'si gharmāya dīṣva
verses.en: Thou art a zone for Aditi, a diadem for Indrani, Pushan art thou. Spare some for the Gharma.

verses.sa: अश्विभ्यां पिन्वस्व सरस्वत्यै पिन्वस्वेन्द्राय पिन्वस्व। स्वाहेन्द्रवत् स्वाहेन्द्रवत् स्वाहेन्द्रवत्॥
verses.tr: aśvibhyāṃ pinvasva sarasvatyai pinvasvendrāya pinvasva svāhendravat svāhendravat svāhendravat
verses.en: Overflow for the Asvins. Overflow for Sarasvati. Overflow for Indra. All-hail, what belongs to Indra! All-hail, what belongs to Indra! All-hail, what belongs to Indra!

verses.sa: यस्ते स्तनः शशयो यो मयोभूर्यो रत्नधा वसुविद्यः सुदत्रः। येन विश्वा पुष्यसि वार्याणि सरस्वति तमिह धातवेऽकः। उर्वन्तरिक्षमन्वेमि॥
verses.tr: yaste stanaḥ śaśayo yo mayobhūryo ratnadhā vasuvidyaḥ sudatraḥ yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tamiha dhātave'kaḥ urvantarikṣamanvemi
verses.en: That breast of thine, exhaustless, fount of pleasure, wealth-giver, treasure-finder, free-bestower, Wherewith thou rearest all things that are choicest,—bring that, Sarasvati, that we may drain it. Throughout the spacious middle air I travel.

verses.sa: गायत्रं छन्दोऽसि त्रैष्टुभं छन्दोऽसि द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां त्वा परि गृह्णाम्यन्तरिक्षेणोप यच्छामि। इन्द्राश्विना मधुनः सारघस्य घर्मं पात वसवो यजत वाट्। स्वाहा सूर्यस्य रश्मये वृष्टिवनये॥
verses.tr: gāyatraṃ chando'si traiṣṭubhaṃ chando'si dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā pari gṛhṇāmyantarikṣeṇopa yacchāmi indrāśvinā madhunaḥ sāraghasya gharmaṃ pāta vasavo yajata vāṭ svāhā sūryasya raśmaye vṛṣṭivanaye
verses.en: Thou art G-yatra metre. Thou art Trishtup metre. With Heaven and Earth I grasp thee. With the Firmament! Raise thee up. Indra and Asvins, drink ye the hot draught of sweet honey: sacrifice, ye Vasus. Vat! All-hail to the rain-winning beam of the Sun!

verses.sa: समुद्राय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा सरिराय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा। अनाधृष्याय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा ऽप्रतिधृष्याय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा। अवस्यवे त्वा वाताय स्वाहा ऽशिमिदाय त्वा वाताय स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: samudrāya tvā vātāya svāhā sarirāya tvā vātāya svāhā anādhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā 'pratidhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā avasyave tvā vātāya svāhā 'śimidāya tvā vātāya svāhā
verses.en: Thee with Svaha to Vrata the sea. Thee with Svaha to Vrata the flood. Thee with Svaha to Vrata the unconquerable. Thee with Svaha to Vata the irresistible. Thee with Svaha to Vrata the protection-seeker. Thee with Svahaa to Vrata the non-destructive.

verses.sa: इन्द्राय त्वा वसुमते रुद्रवते स्वाहेन्द्राय त्वाऽऽदित्यवते स्वाहेन्द्राय त्वाऽभिमातिघ्ने स्वाहा। सवित्रे त्व ऋभुमते विभुमते वाजवते स्वाहा बृहस्पतये त्वा विश्वदेव्यावते स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: indrāya tvā vasumate rudravate svāhendrāya tvā''dityavate svāhendrāya tvā'bhimātighne svāhā savitre tva ṛbhumate vibhumate vājavate svāhā bṛhaspataye tvā viśvadevyāvate svāhā
verses.en: Thee with Svahaa to In Indra Lord of Vasus. Thee with Svadha to Indra Lord of Rudras. Thee with Svaha to Indra killer of foes. Thee with Svaha to Savitar attended by Ribhus, Vibhu, and Yama. Thee with Svaha to Brihaspati beloved of all the Gods.

verses.sa: यमाय त्वाऽङ्गिरस्वते पितृमते स्वाहा। स्वाहा घर्माय स्वाहा घर्मः पित्रे॥
verses.tr: yamāya tvā'ṅgirasvate pitṛmate svāhā svāhā gharmāya svāhā gharmaḥ pitre
verses.en: Svaha to Yama attended by the Angirases, attended by the Fathers! Svaha to the Gharma! The Gharma for the Father!

verses.sa: विश्वा आशा दक्षिणसद्विश्वान् देवानयाडिह। स्वाहाकृतस्य घर्मस्य मधोः पिबतमश्विना॥
verses.tr: viśvā āśā dakṣiṇasadviśvān devānayāḍiha svāhākṛtasya gharmasya madhoḥ pibatamaśvinā
verses.en: Here hath he worshipped, seated south, all the sky-regions, all the Gods. Drink, Asvins, of the heated draught, the Svaha-consecrated mead.

verses.sa: दिवि धा इमं यज्ञमिमं यज्ञं दिवि धाः। स्वाहाऽग्नये यज्ञियाय शं यजुर्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: divi dhā imaṃ yajñamimaṃ yajñaṃ divi dhāḥ svāhā'gnaye yajñiyāya śaṃ yajurbhyaḥ
verses.en: In heaven lay thou this sacrifice; lay thou this sacrifice in heaven. To sacrificial Agni hail! May bliss be ours from Dyaus texts,

verses.sa: अश्विना घर्मं पातं हार्द्वानमहर्दिवाभिरूतिभिः। तन्त्रायिणे नमो द्यावापृथिवीभ्याम्॥
verses.tr: aśvinā gharmaṃ pātaṃ hārdvānamahardivābhirūtibhiḥ tantrāyiṇe namo dyāvāpṛthivībhyām
verses.en: Drink, Asvins, with your daily helps, the Gharma, strengthener of hearts. To him who draweth out the thread be homage, and to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa: अपातामश्विना घर्ममनु द्यावापृथिवी अमंसाताम्। इहैव रातयः सन्तु॥
verses.tr: apātāmaśvinā gharmamanu dyāvāpṛthivī amaṃsātām ihaiva rātayaḥ santu
verses.en: The Gharma have the Asvins drunk: with Heaven and Earth have they agreed. Here, verily, be their boons bestowed.

verses.sa: इषे पिन्वस्वोर्जे पिन्वस्व ब्रह्मणे पिन्वस्व क्षत्राय पिन्वस्व द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां पिन्वस्व। धर्मासि सुधर्मामेन्यस्मे नृम्णानि धारय ब्रह्म धारय क्षत्रं धारय विशं धारय॥
verses.tr: iṣe pinvasvorje pinvasva brahmaṇe pinvasva kṣatrāya pinvasva dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pinvasva dharmāsi sudharmāmenyasme nṛmṇāni dhāraya brahma dhāraya kṣatraṃ dhāraya viśaṃ dhāraya
verses.en: Overflow for food. Overflow for energy. Overflow for the Priesthood. Overflow for the Nobility. Overflow for Heaven and Earth. Thou, O duteous one, art Duty. Innocent one, in us establish manly powers; establish the People.

verses.sa: स्वाहा पूष्णे शरसे स्वाहा ग्रावभ्यः स्वाहा प्रतिरवेभ्यः। स्वाहा पितृभ्य ऊर्ध्वबर्हिर्भ्यो घर्मपावभ्यः स्वाहा द्यावापृथिवीभ्यां स्वाहा विश्वेभ्यो देवेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: svāhā pūṣṇe śarase svāhā grāvabhyaḥ svāhā pratiravebhyaḥ svāhā pitṛbhya ūrdhvabarhirbhyo gharmapāvabhyaḥ svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ svāhā viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ
verses.en: All-hail to Pushan, to the milk's skin! All-hail to the press-stones! All-hail to their echoes! All-hail to the Fathers who are above the grass, who drink the Gharma! All-hall to Heaven and Earth! All-hail to the All-Gods!

verses.sa: स्वाहा रुद्राय रुद्रहूतये स्वाहा सं ज्योतिषा ज्योतिः। अहः केतुना जुषतां सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा। रात्रिः केतुना जुषतां सुज्योतिर्ज्योतिषा स्वाहा। मधु हुतमिन्द्रतमे अग्नावश्याम ते देव घर्म नमस्ते अस्तु मा मा हिंसीः॥
verses.tr: svāhā rudrāya rudrahūtaye svāhā saṃ jyotiṣā jyotiḥ ahaḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā rātriḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā madhu hutamindratame agnāvaśyāma te deva gharma namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ
verses.en: All-hail to Rudra invoked by worshippers! All-hail! Let light combine with light. May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light, accept. All-hail! May Night together with her sheen, fair-lighted with her light, accept. All-hail! May we enjoy the mead offered in most Indra-like Agni. Homage to thee, divine Gharma! Do not thou injure me.

verses.sa: अभीमं महिमा दिवं विप्रो बभूव सप्रथाः। उत श्रवसा पृथिवीं सं सीदस्व महाँ२ असि रोचस्व देववीतमः॥
verses.tr: abhīmaṃ mahimā divaṃ vipro babhūva saprathāḥ uta śravasā pṛthivīṃ saṃ sīdasva mahāṃ2 asi rocasva devavītamaḥ
verses.en: Thy far-spread majesty, instinct with wisdom, hath surpassed this heaven. And, with its glorious fame, the earth. Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! Loose the smoke ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sa: या ते घर्म दिव्या शुग्या गायत्र्यां हविर्धाने। सा त आ प्यायतां निष्टयायतां तस्यै ते स्वाहा। या ते घर्मान्तरिक्षे शुग्या त्रिष्टुभ्याग्नीध्रे। सा त आ प्यायतां निष्टयायतां तस्यै ते स्वाहा। या ते घर्म पृथिव्यां शुग्या जगत्यां सदस्या। सा त आ प्यायतां निष्टयायतां तस्यै ते स्वाहा॥
verses.tr: yā te gharma divyā śugyā gāyatryāṃ havirdhāne sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā yā te gharmāntarikṣe śugyā triṣṭubhyāgnīdhre sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā yā te gharma pṛthivyāṃ śugyā jagatyāṃ sadasyā sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā
verses.en: Gharma, that heavenly light of thine in Gayatri, in the Soma-store,—May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine in air, in Trishtup, in the sacred hearth,—May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine on earth, in Jagati, of the priest's shed,—May that increase and be confirmed for thee, that light.

verses.sa: क्षत्रस्य त्वा परस्पाय ब्रह्मणस्तन्वं पाहि। विशस्त्वा धर्मणा वयमनु क्रामाम सुविताय नव्यसे॥
verses.tr: kṣatrasya tvā paraspāya brahmaṇastanvaṃ pāhi viśastvā dharmaṇā vayamanu krāmāma suvitāya navyase
verses.en: Thee for the sure protection of the Nobles. Guard thou from injury the Brahman's body. We follow thee in interest of the People, for the renewal of our peace and comfort.

verses.sa: चतुः स्रक्तिर्नाभिरृतस्य सप्रथाः स नो विश्वायुः सप्रथाः स नः सर्वायुः सप्रथाः। अप द्वेषो अप ह्वरोऽन्यव्रतस्य सश्चिम॥
verses.tr: catuḥ sraktirnābhirṛtasya saprathāḥ sa no viśvāyuḥ saprathāḥ sa naḥ sarvāyuḥ saprathāḥ apa dveṣo apa hvaro'nyavratasya saścima
verses.en: S|uare, far-spread is the sacrifice's navel: it spreads for us wide, full of all existence, spreads wide for us full of complete existence. We turn against the hate and guiles of him who keeps an alien law.

verses.sa: घर्मैतत्ते पुरीषं तेन वर्धस्व चा च प्यायस्व। वर्धिषीमहि च वयमा च प्यासिषीमहि॥
verses.tr: gharmaitatte purīṣaṃ tena vardhasva cā ca pyāyasva vardhiṣīmahi ca vayamā ca pyāsiṣīmahi
verses.en: This, Gharma! is thy liquid store. Swell out and wax in strength thereby. May we too grow in strength and wax to greatness.

verses.sa: अचिक्रदद्वृषा हरिर्महान्मित्रो न दर्शतः। सं सूर्येण दिद्युतदुदधिर्निधिः॥
verses.tr: acikradadvṛṣā harirmahānmitro na darśataḥ saṃ sūryeṇa didyutadudadhirnidhiḥ
verses.en: Loudly the tawny Stallion neighed, mighty, like Mitra fair to see. Together with the Sun the sea, the store shone out with flashing light.

verses.sa: सुमित्रिया न आप ओषधयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मः॥
verses.tr: sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ
verses.en: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

verses.sa: उद्वयं तमसस्परि स्वः पश्यन्त उत्तरम्। देवं देवत्रा सूर्यमगन्म ज्योतिरुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: udvayaṃ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam
verses.en: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come, To Surya, God among the Gods, the light that is most, excellent.

verses.sa: एधोऽस्येधिषीमहि समिदसि तेजोऽसि तेजो मयि धेहि॥
verses.tr: edho'syedhiṣīmahi samidasi tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi
verses.en: A brand art thou, fain would we thrive. Fuel art thou, and splendour: Give me splendour.

verses.sa: यावती द्यावापृथिवी यावच्च सप्त सिन्धवो वितस्थिरे। तवन्तमिन्द्र ते ग्रहमूर्जा गृह्णाम्यक्षितं मयि गृह्णाम्यक्षितम्॥
verses.tr: yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī yāvacca sapta sindhavo vitasthire tavantamindra te grahamūrjā gṛhṇāmyakṣitaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmyakṣitam
verses.en: Far as the heaven and earth are spread in compass, far as the Seven Rivers are extended, So vast thy cUp which I with strength am taking, Indra, unharmed in me, uninjured ever.

verses.sa: मयि त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहन्मयि दक्षो मयि क्रतुः। घर्मस्त्रिशुग्वि राजति विराजा ज्योतिषा सह ब्रह्मणा तेजसा सह॥
verses.tr: mayi tyadindriyaṃ bṛhanmayi dakṣo mayi kratuḥ gharmastriśugvi rājati virājā jyotiṣā saha brahmaṇā tejasā saha
verses.en: In me be that great hero power, in me be strength and mental force. The Gharma shines with triple light, with lustre fulgent far away, With holy lore, with brilliancy.

verses.sa: पयसो रेत आभृतं तस्य दोहमशीमह्युत्तरामुत्तरां समाम्। त्विषः संवृक् क्रत्वे दक्षस्य ते सुषुम्णस्य ते सुषुम्णाग्निहुतः। इन्द्रपीतस्य प्रजापतिभक्षितस्य मधुमत उपहूत उपहूतस्य भक्षयामि॥
verses.tr: payaso reta ābhṛtaṃ tasya dohamaśīmahyuttarāmuttarāṃ samām tviṣaḥ saṃvṛk kratve dakṣasya te suṣumṇasya te suṣumṇāgnihutaḥ indrapītasya prajāpatibhakṣitasya madhumata upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi
verses.en: Brought hither is the seed of milk. Through, each succeed ing year may we enjoy the bliss of draining it. Invited, I enjoy a Share of that which hath been offered me, the savoury draughtby by Indra drunk and tasted by Prajapati.
